brief.Text: The Unredeemed will test you. Cull five Den-Losa, five El-Kael, and Car-Mea the Custodian in the same area. Then return.

progress.Text: Den-Losa, El-Kael, and Car-Mea. Then we speak of the Second Edition.

turnin.Text: The temple is quieter. Take Kanel's Story - Second Edition. Scott Free waits near 1634 by 568. {completequest AO11}

after.Text: Scott Free has the next pages.
